status-note: Follows the data status line on the Health page of the Operations dashboard. "Source": the channel a message came through (web, Telegram…). "Socio" (an AI agent) and "Space" (a shared area of pages) are product nouns.
empty: Shown on Health while the analytics store hasn't copied any data yet.
not-yet: Stands in for {{offsite}} or {{ago}} when no off-site copy was made yet ("off-site not yet").
failed: Badge: the last restore drill failed.
freshness.title: Card title: backups, and how fresh the dashboard's copied data is.
freshness.label: Accessible name of the card's list.
freshness.analytics: Row label: the analytics store that copies data for the dashboard.
freshness.state.ready: Each freshness.state.*: a badge with the analytics store's state.
freshness.rebuilding-progress: Badge while the analytics store rebuilds; {{progress}} is how far it got.
freshness.mode-service: Where analytics runs: as its own service.
freshness.mode-process: Where analytics runs: inside this server's process.
freshness.caught-up: {{ago}} is how long ago, already in words ("4 minutes ago").
freshness.analytics-off: Keep OPS_ANALYTICS_MODE=off as is: it's a setting's name and value.
freshness.deployment: Row label: the numbers about this deployment's containers.
freshness.deployment-off: Keep COMPUTER_DISK_USAGE_URL as is: it's a setting's name. "They" are the deployment metrics.
freshness.deployment-state.ok: Each freshness.deployment-state.*: a badge, whether the deployment's numbers are current.
freshness.measured: {{ago}} is how long ago, already in words ("4 minutes ago").
freshness.services: How many services (containers) the deployment runs.
freshness.unlimited: How many services have no memory limit (a warning).
freshness.backup-none: No backup ran yet; the _off form: scheduled backups are turned off.
freshness.backup-last: The last backup: {{when}} a date and time, {{ago}} how long ago in words, {{hours}} how often it runs. The _off forms: scheduled backups are off. The _offsite forms add when the off-site copy was made: {{offsite}} is how long ago in words, or "not yet".
freshness.copy: Row label: the database's continuous copy (it streams every write to a copy).
freshness.copy-state.critical: Each freshness.copy-state.*: a badge with how far behind the continuous copy is.
freshness.last-copied: {{ago}} is how long ago, already in words.
freshness.wal: The database's write-ahead log and its size ({{size}}, such as 12 MB).
freshness.offsite: When the off-site copy was last sent: {{ago}} how long ago in words, or "not yet".
freshness.drill: Row label: a test that restores a backup to check it works.
freshness.passed: Badge: the last restore drill passed.
freshness.every-days: How often the restore drill runs.
freshness.by-hand: The restore drill runs only when an admin starts it.
freshness.not-run-every: The restore drill hasn't run yet; it runs every {{count}} days.
freshness.stale: Badge: this data source hasn't been copied for too long.
freshness.copied: When a data source was last copied into analytics; {{ago}} how long ago, in words.
freshness.source.agent_runs: Each freshness.source.*: a kind of data the analytics store copies, as a row label. "Turns": answers from a socio (an AI agent).
freshness.source.dimensions: "Socios" (AI agents) and "Spaces" (shared areas of pages) are product nouns.
freshness.source.retention: What the workspace keeps and for how long.
freshness.source.issues: "Improvements board": the workspace's board of issues and requests.
freshness.source.dot_requests: What people asked a socio for that it can't do yet.
freshness.source.run_refs: Which pages and data the turns read.
freshness.source.cost: "Cost pools": a self-hosted model backend's running costs, shared out over its turns.
freshness.source.work_cycles: A Room's (a shared chat's) runs of socio work on one message.
apps.title: Row label: mini apps (small apps the workspace builds and runs) and their self-healing check.
apps.check-failing: Badge: the check of the workspace's apps fails.
apps.not-healthy: Badge: how many apps aren't healthy.
apps.failing-since: {{ago}} is how long ago in words; {{error}} the last error, untranslated.
apps.watched: How many apps are watched, and how many recovered by themselves today.
apps.checked: When apps were last checked; {{ago}} how long ago in words.
apps.state.healthy: Each apps.state.*: a badge with an app's health.
apps.attempt: Which recovery attempt this is, of the most allowed.
apps.admins-told: When admins were told about the failing app; {{ago}} how long ago in words.
apps.last-recovered: {{ago}} is how long ago in words.
